Staying in this winter doesn’t have to be drab if you have the right home for entertaining.

From anchor kitchens with island benches, butler’s pantries, and seamless indoor-outdoor flow to built-in bars, cellars, home theatres, fire pits, and outdoor amenities, many features make a home the perfect entertainer’s haven.

Here are five of the best homes for sale in Sydney to entertain.

This property is in one of Chiswick’s most coveted waterside pockets, offering north-westerly water views.

Set on an 878.9 sq m (approx.) block, the home’s dual-level layout provides living areas on each level.

Floor one features an open-plan kitchen, meals, and dining area, which connects to the outdoor entertaining area through soaring glass doors and double-height windows that capture natural light.

Outside, there is a lap pool, surrounded by an expansive patio, a desk with storage, a bathroom, and a sauna.

The gourmet kitchen sits at the heart of this Vaucluse family home, serving as an ideal entertainment hub.

The kitchen features a gourmet stone island, premium appliances, and glass sliders that open to multiple alfresco areas and a swimming pool.

Set over four levels, the home includes spacious formal and informal living and dining areas, a wine cellar, and sunny, private balconies that offer views of Vaucluse House.

The property is only a short walk from Nielsen Park, Hermitage Foreshore, and Milk Beach, and is close to Vaucluse Village and schools.

The interior of this Clovelly residence captures natural light across its two levels, creating a sense of warmth and space.

The indoor-outdoor living is a standout, with the open-plan living, kitchen, and dining zone opening to the outdoor terrace.

There is an additional terrace and outdoor entertaining deck that frames the heated swimming pool, an alfresco deck with a dining area, and an outdoor kitchen.

The home also includes four bedrooms, an additional living area, and a two-car garage.

Set for auction on July 18, this Gordon home is the ideal family entertainer.

Crafted by the renowned Byron & Co, the five-bedroom home is more like a resort than a house, with a variety of features to make staying in enjoyable.

There’s a gourmet chef’s kitchen with a Caesarstone waterfall island and multiple living areas across two levels, including a media room and a wine cellar with shelving for 500-plus bottles.

Outdoors, you’ll find a large lawn and landscaped gardens, a reinforced-steel, undercover entertainment deck with an electric Aluxor shade awning, and a heated pool and a cedar hot tub.

This home offers a balance of space, functionality, and flexibility for entertaining.

There’s an expansive open-plan family, kitchen, and dining area, along with other distinct living and entertaining zones across the four levels, including a formal lounge near the entry and a cellar with a wine rack.

The kitchen features a butler’s pantry, and outside, the private backyard with a pool and entertaining space includes a large alfresco terrace that flows from the open-plan family, kitchen, and dining zone.

Other features of the home include an internal lift serving all floors, a secure garage, and harbour views.
